plugin.name: After the Companions questline
plugin.description: The tomb stays sealed until Glory of the Dead is complete. Then the sarcophagus lid and one bridge cage piece fade away, and Ysgramor lies in the open sarcophagus wearing the set.

plugin.name: From the start (no Companions questline)
plugin.description: For games where the Companions questline cannot be finished, such as setups that remove the Companions. The first time you enter the tomb, the portcullis in the entrance chamber opens (normally it needs Wuuthrad on Ysgramor's statue) and the sarcophagus is open, with no quest needed. Adds one small light plugin, "YsgramorsArmor - No Companions requirement.esp", that changes a single setting of this mod. It can be turned on or off on a save you already have.
